description: The sweeper fan-out ships the FULL user row as Inngest event data. inngest/functions.js:35 `users.map((u) => ({ name: "lm/wake.user", data: u }))` sends every column selected by supaUsers (scheduler.js:43): uid, name, phone, paid, calendar_provider, home_address, gmail_account_id, telegram_chat_id, call_language, wake_policy. phone, name, home_address, gmail_account_id, and telegram_chat_id are PII. These events are transmitted to and RETAINED in Inngest Cloud event history (durable event log), creating an off-platform PII store outside Supabase with its own retention/access controls. The per-user fns only need `uid` (then re-fetch via Supabase) or a minimal {uid,phone,name,call_language} subset. Shipping the whole row is an unnecessary PII egress + payload-size cost on every fan-out (N users x 3 sweepers x 1-20 ticks).

evidence.snippet: await step.sendEvent("fan", users.map((u) => ({ name: "lm/wake.user", data: u })));
